value.body: Several government-owned companies maintain aircraft. Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) builds and overhauls military aircraft and helicopters; AI Engineering Services Ltd (AIESL), which stayed with the Government after Air India's sale, maintains airliners; and Pawan Hans operates helicopters. They recruit technicians and aircraft maintenance engineers through their own notices.

items.label: Recruitment
items.note: Many technician posts are fixed-term contracts

items.label: HAL regular employees
items.note: As on 31 March 2024: ~7,500 executives and ~16,300 non-executives; HAL only, not AIESL or Pawan Hans

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Eligibility is set post by post: some posts accept an AME course or diploma, others need a DGCA licence with a type endorsement and experience. Selection is usually a written test and/or interview, then document checks and a medical.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are irregular and sometimes limited to particular bases or cities.
Contract posts may or may not lead to permanent positions.
HAL's work is mainly defence aircraft; AIESL's and Pawan Hans' is civil.
